# Maansi Jain

> Maansi Jain is a Berlin-based conceptual artist working across performance, sculpture, photography, text, works on paper and installation. She has guest lectured at New York University and has more than two decades of teaching experience. Through STUDIO JAIN she runs small, artist-led art workshops in Berlin, bookable on GetYourGuide.

## Art workshops in Berlin (STUDIO JAIN)

Hands-on studio workshops with the artist: a creative thing to do in Berlin for visitors and locals, on your own, with a friend or as a small group. Most sessions need no art experience. Sessions take place at STUDIO JAIN in Berlin; each costs €160 per person or €50 for students. Dates, meeting point and cancellation terms are on each GetYourGuide listing.

- [All workshops](https://maansijain.com/workshops/): overview of the four workshops, with booking questions answered
- [Draw Otherwise](https://maansijain.com/workshops/draw-otherwise/): drawing workshop exploring colour and perception (two-handed drawing, blind contour, three-colour portraits, watercolour reveals). 75–90 minutes, in English, beginners welcome. [Book on GetYourGuide](https://www.getyourguide.com/berlin-l17/berlin-draw-otherwise-artist-led-drawing-workshop-t1464155/)
- [Words Become Art](https://maansijain.com/workshops/words-become-art/): language and conceptual art workshop where sentences become drawings, gestures and shared experiments. 90 minutes, in English or German. [Book on GetYourGuide](https://www.getyourguide.com/berlin-l17/berlin-words-become-art-artist-led-workshops-t1466996/)
- [Make the Ordinary Strange](https://maansijain.com/workshops/make-the-ordinary-strange/): object and sculpture workshop using everyday things, paper sculpture, museum labels and humour. 75 minutes, in English or German, up to 8 participants. [Book on GetYourGuide](https://www.getyourguide.com/berlin-l17/berlin-make-the-ordinary-strange-artist-led-workshop-t1469918/)
- [Perform the Image](https://maansijain.com/workshops/perform-the-image/): photography and performance workshop staging gestures, props and visual metaphors. 75 minutes, in English or German, welcomes non-artists. [Book on GetYourGuide](https://www.getyourguide.com/berlin-l17/berlin-perform-the-image-artist-led-art-workshop-t1469937/)
